xhtml:div.xhtml:div:
SEQUENCE · filled arrow: synchronous call · open arrow: asynchronous message · dashed arrow: reply.
Orange: client/provider · navy: component/service · green: data/cache. Fragments use source predicates; ref expands a subordinate interaction.
Content findAccessibleSharedReelIds ignores userId; it filters conversationId plus ready/indexed Reel state, without independent current visibility/Friend/membership enforcement.
metadataShortcut := route.reelQuestionType == REEL_METADATA && scope.length > 0.
chronologicalShortcut := plan.sourceOrder == ASC && scope.length == 1 && includeTranscript && !includeVisual; later branches exclude earlier shortcuts.
Main view is the shared-Reel question path; recommendation action is an independent destination and is outside this focused retrieval scope.
Tool-call cap does not imply parallel execution: selected calls are awaited serially in the source.
